hooks.command: echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(git add -A|git add \.|git commit -a|--no-verify|git push --force)' && echo 'BLOCKED: Use explicit git add <file>, never -A/./commit -a/--no-verify/push --force. See CLAUDE.md rule 1.' && exit 1 || exit 0
FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP '"file_path":\s*"\K[^"]+'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5;; */vps/*.js|*/vps/**/*.js) node --check "$FILE" 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
cat docs/index.md 2>/dev/null; echo ''; echo '--- DoD report obligatoire en fin de session (voir /dod-report) ---'

CODE_CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' || echo 0); REPORT_TOUCHED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'docs/prompts/REPORT/' || echo 0); if [ "$CODE_CHANGED" -gt 0 ] && [ "$REPORT_TOUCHED" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Code was changed but no DoD report written. Run /dod-report first.'; exit 1; fi; exit 0
